system.description: This odd "wheel," the size of a normal wagon wheel, is useless on roads and other flat terrain because it is perfectly square. However, when mounted properly on a wagon, it magically allows movement through mountain and desert terrain where there is no road. A wagon with one square wheel can be pulled by two horses and can move at 20'/turn; with two wheels, 30'/turn; with three, 40'/turn; and with four, the normal rate of 60'/turn is possible.
